research_question: Given the supplied adenylate-kinase endpoint structures and permitted source context, what source facts and uncertainties must be retained before any future system evaluates a trajectory, ensemble, or non-reference structure?

source_materials.source_locator: Raghuram, DynaMune preprint 2026, DOI 10.21203/rs.3.rs-8999467/v1; local text derivative Section 3.1 lines 397-710.
permitted_facts: The case uses closed PDB 1AKE and open PDB 4AKE adenylate-kinase endpoint structures.
The described system preparation removes solvent and heteroatoms and does not perform structural refinement before the endpoint comparison.
The public capsule supplies endpoint coordinates only; it does not supply an ADK trajectory, ensemble, or validated dynamical reference.
Each supplied endpoint contains one Chain A C-alpha coordinate per residue 1-214.
The two frozen coordinate arrays have the same declared residue coverage for a future direct reference-relative comparison.
The arrays are static endpoint coordinates rather than trajectory samples.

data_assets.public_description: Closed-state endpoint derivative containing Chain A C-alpha coordinates only.
Open-state endpoint derivative containing Chain A C-alpha coordinates only.
